'''Eulyn''' was a [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. The [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of widowed [[Geologist/Legends|geologist]] [[Adari Vaal]], Eulyn cared for her two grandchildren, [[Tona Vaal|Tona]] and [[Finn Vaal|Finn]], in a [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] house in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]] inherited after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of her son-in-law, [[Zhari Vaal]]. Adari became notorious for teachings contrary to the common [[Skyborn|religion]] of the [[Time/Legends|time]], leading Eulyn to regard her daughter as a heretic. After their house was bombarded with rocks by an angry mob, Adari fled and stumbled across a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], who proclaimed themselves to be [[Deity/Legends|gods]]. Although Adari was honored for her role, Eulyn never truly understood her daughter's canonization and died sometime before [[4975 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I knew you'd do something like this. I've always said all that digging around in the filth would do you no good. And arguing with the Neshtovar! Why do you always have to be ''right''?|Eulyn, to Adari Vaal|<ref name="skyborn" />}}
[[File:Adari_Vaal.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Adari Vaal, Eulyn's daughter]]
A [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Eulyn was a native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], living during the era of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Eulyn had a daughter named [[Adari Vaal|Adari]], a [[Geologist/Legends|geologist]] who [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a member of the planet's ruling [[Neshtovar]], [[Zhari Vaal]]. Eulyn was largely responsible for the [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]]&mdash;seeking to solidify her family's future position, she lobbied for the union for [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. After Vaal's [[Death/Legends|death]] in an accident while riding an [[uvak]] beast, Eulyn and Adari inherited a [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] house in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]], where Eulyn took care of her grandchildren, [[Tona Vaal|Tona]] and [[Finn Vaal|Finn]]. Through her work in geology, Adari uncovered clues about the natural formation of the Keshiri landscape that contradicted the widely-held religious belief that the planet's continents were formed by the [[Blood/Legends|blood]] of the Keshiri [[Deity/Legends|gods]], the [[Skyborn]], and began teaching these findings to other Keshiri. Generally disapproving of her daughter's profession, and an ardent adherent to the religion, Eulyn was appalled by her daughter's discoveries and believed her to be a heretic.<ref name="skyborn" />

In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], Adari testified about the validity of her findings to the Neshtovar, leading to mobs descending upon Eulyn and Adari's household and pelting it with rocks. The torrent of abuse became so bad, in fact, that Adari sent Eulyn and the children to stay at her [[Adari Vaal's uncle|uncle's]] home. As for Adari, she fled the angry Keshiri on her husband's old uvak, [[Nink (uvak)|Nink]], and stumbled onto the site of a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] crash site high in the [[Takara Mountains|Cetajan Mountains]]. Adari discovered a group of surviving Sith and led them back to society. The Sith, led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Yaru Korsin]], proclaimed themselves to be the Skyborn, and Adari was honored for her role.<ref name="skyborn" /> Just as she did not understand her daughter's supposed heresy, Eulyn failed to understand Adari's canonization, and she died sometime before the year [[4975 BBY]].<ref name="savior" /> After her daughter's death, Adari's [[Adari's personal memoirs|personal memoirs]] were found, written during her [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] in the far-off continent of [[Alanciar]], and included a few tart passages about Eulyn.<ref name="pandemonium">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Adari, listen! They're hitting the roof now!''"<br />"''That's actually thunder.''"<br />"''It's proof, that's what it is! The Skyborn have forsaken you.|Eulyn and Adari Vaal|<ref name="skyborn" />}}
Eulyn was a devout follower of the Skyborn religion and, as such, was appalled by her daughter's perceived heresy. Eulyn did not understand Adari's adherence to her theories, her profession,<ref name="skyborn" /> or her veneration after the arrival of the Sith,<ref name="savior" /> and tended to be very argumentative with her daughter. She was very ambitious regarding her family's position, lobbying heavily for Adari to marry a powerful member of the Neshtovar, and she was elated when she obtained an upscale wooden house. Eulyn had [[Color/Legends|violet]] skin and dark [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="skyborn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eulyn first appeared in ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]'', a [[2009]] [[eBook]] by [[John Jackson Miller]].<ref name="skyborn" />
